root.name: ライオンデルバセル・インダストリーズ

relations.text: ルイジアナ・インテグレイテッド・ポリエチレン合弁を、サソルのUS子会社と共同で保有する
relations.text_en: LyondellBasell shares ownership of the Louisiana Integrated PolyEthylene JV with Sasol Chemicals (USA)

source.label: LyondellBasell 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We share ownership in the Louisiana Integrated PolyEthylene JV LLC joint venture (the “Louisiana Joint Venture”) with Sasol Chemicals (USA) LLC.

relations.text: 合弁の各パートナーは、エタン原料を持分に応じて出し、製品も現物で持分に応じて引き取る
relations.text_en: Each partner supplies its pro-rata share of ethane and takes pro-rata shares of cracker and polyethylene products in kind

source.label: LyondellBasell 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Under the terms of the joint venture agreement, each partner provides pro-rata share of ethane feedstocks and off-takes pro-rata shares of cracker and polyethylene products in-kind.

companies.name: コベストロ
companies.sub: 高機能素材・合弁相手

relations.text: 米国とオランダの酸化プロピレン合弁2件を、コベストロと共同で保有している
relations.text_en: It co-owns a U.S. propylene oxide JV and a European PO/styrene JV with Covestro

source.label: LyondellBasell 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We share ownership with Covestro PO LLC, a subsidiary of Covestro AG (collectively “Covestro”), in a U.S. propylene oxide (“PO”) joint venture located in Texas (the “U.S. PO Joint Venture”) and a PO/styrene monomer (“SM” or “styrene”) joint venture located in The Netherlands (the “European PO Joint Venture”).

companies.name: ナショナル・ペトロケミカル・インダストリアル

relations.text: 2024年5月に、サウジの石化会社の35%の持分をアルジャインから約5億ドルで取得した
relations.text_en: In May 2024 it acquired a 35% interest in this Saudi company from Alujain for about $500 million

source.label: LyondellBasell 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In May 2024, we acquired a 35 % interest in Saudi Arabia-based National Petrochemical Industrial Company from Alujain Corporation for approximately $ 500 million.

relations.text: この合弁の生産品の大半は、同社のグローバル販売チームが販売する
relations.text_en: LyondellBasell markets the majority of the joint venture's off-take through its global sales team

source.label: LyondellBasell 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We market the majority of the off-take through our global sales team.
